verdict.rationale: Box documents a REST API that can be called non-interactively, for example with a developer token via curl, and mentions a Box CLI for giving agents access to content. Together these show scriptable, headless operation. However, the evidence never documents CI usage or non-interactive authentication suited to unattended pipelines. Missing for 10: CI/pipeline integration docs, Box CLI usage and installation details, non-interactive service-account or long-lived auth for unattended runs, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Give AI agents access to Box content through the Box CLI or the Box MCP server.
Replace <ACCESS_TOKEN> with a developer token and run: curl https://api.box.com/2.0/users/me
API requests use the base URL `https://api.box.com/2.0` and require an OAuth 2.0 access token
